# Pull Request Template

## Summary
Provide a concise summary of the changes in this PR.

## Related Issue
Link the issue this PR addresses (if applicable).  
Example: Closes #123

## Type of Change
Select all that apply:
- [ ] Bug fix  
- [ ] New feature  
- [ ] Documentation update  
- [ ] Refactor  
- [ ] Other (explain below)

## Description of Changes
Explain what was changed and why.  
Include any relevant context, reasoning, or design decisions.

## Screenshots / Visuals (if applicable)
Add screenshots or media that help reviewers understand the change.

## Testing
Describe how you tested the changes.  
Include steps, environment details, or commands used.

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project’s style guidelines  
- [ ] I have tested my changes  
- [ ] I have updated documentation if needed  
- [ ] I have referenced the related issue  
- [ ] This PR is scoped, focused, and ready for review  

> **Note:**  
> PRs for issues **not** tagged as contributor‑friendly may be closed without review.
